typeContract.note: match is synthesised by lesson.html from day.keyTerms and graph is drawn by renderGraph; neither has a schema fragment in qtpl(), so the prompt cannot ask for them. Everything in `emittable` has both a schema and a renderer.

proposedNewTypes.why: Two overlapping sets with a shared region - supported by the interleaving/discrimination evidence for confusable categories.
proposedNewTypes.renderingWork: SFDiagramKit already draws a venn layout for DIAGRAMS, but there is no question card: needs a schema fragment, SPECIAL_TYPES entries, an injector, a renderer with drag-or-select interaction, a grader, and a feynmanConcept case.

proposedNewTypes.why: Placing values on a line is the standard representation task for fractions, negatives and inequalities (multiple-representations evidence).
proposedNewTypes.renderingWork: curatedDiagramSVG has a number-line template for display only. A question card needs an interactive positional input and tolerance-based grading, closest to the existing estimate grader.

proposedNewTypes.why: Labelling a supplied diagram is the dominant biology/geography assessment format and is pure retrieval.
proposedNewTypes.renderingWork: Needs hotspot coordinates per template, a drag-or-select renderer, and per-label grading. Highest effort of the three.
